purpose: A numeric authoring reference for fitting the accepted MOV-001 gait to Patient 01 proportions.
exclusions: No private raster pixels are embedded or derived into an output image.
This is not final character art, runtime integration, or owner acceptance.

observedSilhouette.method: Direct original-resolution visual review plus alpha bounds and row/color-range inspection; ranges are approximate unless explicitly marked exact.

eastRightView.note: The shoulder joint is hidden inside the jacket; the torso hem is separate from the lower sleeve and hand extent.

westLeftView.note: The shoulder joint is hidden inside the jacket. The independently authored outline and clothing details are asymmetric with the east master.

observedSilhouette.idleShoeObservation: The far shoe appears higher than the near shoe in both idle masters. The pixels do not establish a shorter anatomical leg; depth stagger, pose, and occlusion are all plausible.

inferredAnatomy.warning: Clothing, overlap, and the idle stance occlude shoulder, hip, knee, ankle, and far-limb centers. These are authoring estimates, not recovered anatomy.

schematicVisibilityOffsets.hips: Both anatomical hip centers use the side-view axis x=64.
schematicVisibilityOffsets.classification: Shoulder offsets keep both arm paths visible in the vector study. They are display offsets within the estimated shoulder envelope, not recovered anatomical depth.

doNotUse: whole-character raster flip as an authored opposite view
joint estimates as claims of anatomical precision

registration.authoredWalkPolicy: Use this stable isotropic fit, per-view source axis, and explicit phase bob for all eight frames; never align or scale a changing silhouette independently.

groundPolicy.choice: Normalize both anatomical feet to one schematic ground edge at y=181 when planted.
groundPolicy.reason: The idle far-shoe height is depth/pose ambiguous and cannot justify different leg lengths.
groundPolicy.deferred: GS-010 decides whether final raster art retains a constant far-depth offset while preserving equal anatomical segment lengths.

boundsAssessment.note: The authored stride uses the transparent side margins of the 448px masters. Final clothed raster extents may be wider and require GS-010 review, but must keep this fixed scale and floor registration.

labeledJointReflection.rule: For this symmetric numeric rig, reflect every x coordinate around frame x=64, preserve anatomical R/L labels and the same phase index, then swap far/near rendering order.
labeledJointReflection.scope: Canonical gait coordinates only; this does not claim that independently fitted outline pixels or view-specific source registration are mirror-equal.

plainRasterFlip.warning: A plain raster flip preserves the visually near layer while the opposite camera view changes which anatomical side is near, so its R/L interpretation swaps.
plainRasterFlip.symmetricGaitCorrection: For the canonical symmetric gait identity, apply a half-cycle phase permutation after the anatomy swap.
plainRasterFlip.schematicShoulderOffsetCaveat: The vector guide separates shoulders by 2px for visibility. After an anatomy swap, these display offsets also swap; validate gait identity from support, foot lift, forward leg, and opposing arm semantics rather than demanding pixel equality.

reflectionContract.approvedMasterPolicy: The approved east and west masters are independently generated and asymmetric; do not assert pixel mirror equivalence or replace either with a whole-character flip.

phases.label: right stride
phases.detail: Right leg and left arm reach far forward; the opposite limbs reach back.

phases.label: toward right passing
phases.detail: The right foot settles while the left leg begins to swing through.

phases.label: right support passing
phases.detail: Right leg is straight and planted; left knee is slightly bent; both arms are down.

phases.label: toward left stride
phases.detail: The left foot reaches forward as the arms begin the opposite swing.

phases.label: left stride
phases.detail: Left leg and right arm reach far forward; the opposite limbs reach back.

phases.label: toward left passing
phases.detail: The left foot settles while the right leg begins to swing through.

phases.label: left support passing
phases.detail: Left leg is straight and planted; right knee is slightly bent; both arms are down.

phases.label: toward right stride
phases.detail: The right foot reaches forward as the cycle returns to the first stride.
